title: Generate a modern ed25519 SSH key
summary: Create a secure, modern ed25519 SSH key with a specific filename and increased security rounds. This is recommended for new keys.

steps.explain: Generate an ed25519 key with 32 rounds of key derivation, saving it to a specific file.

placeholders.name: KEY_FILE
placeholders.description: The path and filename where the private key will be saved.

steps.expect: The tool prompts for a passphrase and confirms the key was saved to the specified file.
